notes.title: Update 1.0.2 out now!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h5__o-iCnBw"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Hail sorcerers! Godstone has received a new update based on the recent feedback from the community along with new content![/p][p]Any feedback on the changes for the controllers are especially welcome, I aim to make them as good as possible and your thoughts are the best way to get there.[/p][p]Unless something crazy happens that I have to fix, this will also be the last update before releasing the next big patch adding the next area! I can't wait for you guys to experience the Crimson Gardens.[/p][p]Stay hydrated![/p][p]- Plant[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New content:[/b][/p][p][i]- Added gold as currency, which can be sacrificed as offerings at altars. In the future, it can be used for a ton more such as opening up new dungeon sections and more[/i][/p][p][i]- Added Dark Altars: Sacrifice gold at these altars and choose between 2 blessings. Most of these blessings have a downside and an upside and can heavily alter your character.[/i][/p][p][i]- New enemy; Temptress. A powerful flying primera casting fireballs and cursing the player with Pain. Pain causes a small explosion to grow under your feet whenever you take damage. If you don't move quickly, it erupts dealing damage a second time.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes, fixes and polish:[/b][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused inventory and skillpoint menu to still be on-screen after resurrecting when it was open while you died.[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed the starting controller input to Xbox. This can always be changed to playstation iand back n the settings.[/i][/p][p][i]- switched the default keybindings for controllers so jump is now on X / A, and interact is on up.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where "press X/A to start" text changed with the interact keybinding on controllers while you still had to press X/A to actually start[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed some sounds not being affected by the effects volume setting[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where using X/A as jump caused you to also jump when you pressed X/A to leave the pause menu, same goes for choosing your character in character select and ending dialogs[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed how you leave menues on controllers, having it always be on the B/O button. You can also leave menues by pressing the same button used to enter it.[/i][/p][p][i]- Moving your character with left stick on controller no longer influences your aim[/i][/p][p][i]- You can now see your characters level in the inventory[/i][/p][p][i]- Moved the icon for vault keys away from consumables. They can now be found at the bottom of the inventory next to gold currency and your character level[/i][/p][p][i]- You can now check out how many powerup tomes you have collected on your run in the inventory and how many bonuses they give in total! Hold your cursor over or move the controller selector to the book button next to the stats to see them[/i][/p][p][i]- You can now see how much missile bounce you have in the inventory![/i][/p][p][i]- When looking at items, it now states wether its a crown, relic or consumable[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed the gold text color so its less yellowy		[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with dodging and sword attacking: If you attacked to one direction and tried to dodge in the opposite direction using the movement keys, you would always dodge in the direction of the attack. This now always prioritizes your movement keys.[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed relic: Essence of endurance. Instead of giving 3 extra max endurance on level up, it now restores 1 endurance whenever you enter a new level[/i][/p][p][i]- Polished dialog[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with inventory and skill menu still being open on screen but impossible to interact with if you open them right after you enter the final portal back to the Sanctum[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug with Burning Hands, causing it to always target the direction of the mouse if using controllers[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed the Black Skull relic. It actually works now.[/i][/p][p][i]- Increased the amount of missiles spawned when spreading neferin taint from 10 to 13[/i][/p][p][i]- Increased the sound volume of the Neferin Breath spell[/i][/p][p][i]- Buffed Neferin Taint: It now sticks on walls for longer[/i][/p][p][i]- Buffed the curse debuff: Now when a cursed enemy dies, they spread neferin taint to infect others![/i][/p][p][i]- Nerfed the Stormcaller relic[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the buttons in the UI to not appear when leaving a note[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Controller Support out now!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="VseF-jcz25Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Hey Sorcerers![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It has been a little over 2 entire months, and FINALLY i got this massive update ready for you all! You guys have requested this since the very beginning, so now Godstone has full controller support! [/p][p]On top of this, it was also requested by the community to add a mode where you could play the whole game using only your keyboard! So now there is also a mode for this in the settings menu.[/p][p]Of course, I did not spend 2 entire months for just that, I also added a ton of new levels, changed the levelling system, polished, fixed and balanced. [/p][p]Note: When you open the game you will be met by a block of text due to changes to the savings system. It is merely a guide on how to move your previous save files into the new folder, and you should keep all your previous progress! Feel free to reach out if you have questions or need help either here or in the Discord community.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stay hydrated![/i][/p][p][i]- Plant[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Update List:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]+ 50 new levels, adding a ton to the randomization pool[/i][/p][p][i]Major balancing patch, making the game overall easier based on community feedback. Lots of traps deal less damage, enemies deal overall less damage and some bosses attack a bit slower. [/i][/p][p][i]- Added a new enemy; Monster spawner. This passive brazier does not attack itself, but keeps spawning basic undead until destroyed.[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed up the skeletal frost mage. Previously, they shot their missiles into the air so it fell down on the player. Now it slowly follows the player around instead.[/i][/p][p][i]- Altered and polished a large number of levels[/i][/p][p][i]- Added lighting to Skeletal Frost Mage missiles[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Alakai to attack the player mid-dialog if you trigger an item that can shoot missiles with enough range that hits Alakai right after dialog starts.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Azon to never appear in the game to give you the most awesome quest ever![/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Temerions left and right hand to autocomplete the quest for Azons Cowl when either were destroyed, allowing Azons Cowl to spawn in the game without having done the quest or met Azon at all .....[/i][/p][p][i]- Azon now glows because he is a ghost. Shing, sparkle sparkle[/i][/p][p][i]Natalys, Meris and Alva now all start with +20% energy regeneration. Ablans starting energy regeneration has been increased to 100% bonus.[/i][/p][p][i]You now only need 4 experience in order to level up instead of the previous 10. However, when you level up, the experience needed increases by 3. This makes levelling up faster in the beginning giving a stronger start and slower in the late game making you absolutely screwed.[/i][/p][p][i]Fixed a bug that causes you to get stuck in the prologue when you press ESC at the right moment when the lore intro ends and boat scene begins.[/i][/p][p][i]- Made puzzle buttons slightly more visible[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the mouse to show on screen if you are somehow in the settings menu while a scene runs in-game.[/i][/p][p][i]Fixed an issue at The Dark Tower entrance. There is a chance a chest spawns on the left side, and if it drops a crown, the crown is stuck on the stairs next to it. Luckily the fix was easy, i just moved the chest a couple of pixels to the right ...[/i][/p][p][i]- Added missing collision on stairs at the Dark Tower entrance[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that happened when Gerion saves Alva from the dark tower, and when Gerion talks his illustration is Alva, so it looked like it was Alva talking to herself xD[/i][/p][p][i]The shardbearer now drops items on death[/i][/p][p][i]Fixed a bug when you die in the prologue and then die later in the main game as Gerion, it results in you not getting Gerion's resurrection scene[/i][/p][p][i]Fixed a bug that happened if you get the alternative start, unlock Alva and start playing as her immediately, you can meet Alva in the prison, talk with Alva while playing Alva and the game crashes [/i][/p][p][i]- Imps (those quick flying annoying lil' pricks) can no longer be empowered. It simply makes them too overpowered because they can be so many at once and you have no chance to see what the heck is going on[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed Joans name in the credits which went out of border. She is the voice beind Meris, Alva and Natalys[/i][/p][p][i]- fixed some contradicting dialog[/i][/p][p][i]- Secret markers have been made slightly more visible[/i][/p][p][i]- increased the damage done by Frostbreath and Firebreath by 20%[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where "are you sure you want to *insert action here*" note did not appear when pressing Main Menu or Quit Game in the ESC menu[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Alva to still be in jail after she has been released if you got the alternative start, leave the jail and go back in on that same run[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a minor bug causing two E notifications to show up at the prison door at the same time[/i][/p][p][i]If you get the alternative start, die in the ruins and reenter the sanctum, Ezemat introduces the player to the sanctum as if he has never been there before[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused an invisible door to spawn on the left side of the sanctum, leading people directly into the prison even from the hall of fame ... damn those invisible portals[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed issues with some saved elements not loading properly[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with Chests dropping loot to far to the left, potentially making them overlap with adjacent loot.[/i][/p][p][i]- Corrected typos[/i][/p][p][i]- Evened out the energy cost of of breath abilities so they all cost the same, causing frost breath to cost more and neferin breath to cost less.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused text in the inventory to still show on the screen if you die while in inventory[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed and centered debuff effects and health bars on a number of undead enemies[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed you to open multiple item replacement menues on top of each other by continuously pressing E on the item you are picking up.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Alakai to be stuck in dialog about completing The Well, causing him to talk about it every run.[/i][/p][p][i]- Added a new prop: Candlesticks, aka a little candle held up by an iron stickie thingie[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue allowing you to interact with items while having certain menues open[/i][/p][p][i]- Pressure plates no longer activate if you dodge through them[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that happened if you have a breath ability on main hand and a one time spell on off hand, press right click and then quickly left click, the breath ability messes up completely and becomes very loud. [/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where you walk one direction and dash while attacking in the opposite direction, resulting in you dashing in the direction you attack instead of the direction you move[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed the E notification on the secret statue entrance so it is now centered[/i][/p][p][i]- Items now stop dispaying their info when player dies[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with Neferin Bolt that caused its area of effect to not work correctly[/i][/p][p][i]- Reduced the cost of orb spells from 9 to 7[/i][/p][p][i]- Increased the cost of Burning Hands from 7 to 9[/i][/p][p][i]- Added cooldown to Book of Storms[/i][/p][p][i]- Added cooldown to Burning Stone[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Gilzera to repeat herself when she praises the player for defeating the Guardian of Temerion[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue that caused items to not replace properly if player moved away from them too fast while replacing them[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a missing tile in The Well[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with wizards shooting fire and frost missiles above the players head. Terrible aim.[/i][/p][p][i]- increased the size of gerions dialog illustration[/i][/p][p][i]- Moved Alva's dialog illustration a bit further to the left to better show her frozen hand[/i][/p][p][i]- Added music to Meris' bossfight.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed and polished dialog[/i][/p][p][i]- Meris now starts with Neferin Breath instead of Neferin Bolt[/i][/p][p][i]- Neferin breath has been changed, leaving it stronger than before. It shoots less missiles, but its damage is  vastly increased. It also spreads out more like a shotgun rather than a straight line.[/i][/p][p][i]- Neferin taint (the small explosions that stick on walls) has been buffed, it has a higher chance of sticking to walls for longer, potentially dealing more damage to enemies over time. It also deals 20% more damage.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed you to click other buttons on the UI than the consumables when you cannot carry any more consumables, causing all buttons in the UI to disappear.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the time you can hold your shield up to block damage to decrease the more attack speed you have[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with block that caused it to block damage even after its block time runs out[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed you to attack extremely fast with your sword if you also block with shield at the same time[/i][/p][p][i]- fixed a bug that caused Ezemat to not spawn in Meris' defeat scene[/i][/p][p][i]- Changed Meris' character selection title from Queen that never was to The Dark Sorceress[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where Alakai's dialog pointer appeared too far above his head[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a rare bug that appeared if you defeat Meris specifically on the fifth run, causing 2 ezemats to spawn at once and lacking dialog[/i][/p][p][i]- Meris' boss title now says "Meris, the Dark Sorceress" instead of just Meris[/i][/p][p][i]- Added information to the final portal, letting you know that it takes you back to the Sanctum, but in the future it will take you to the second act; the Crimson Garden[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug where Alakai's appearance effects does not delete themselves when skipping Meris' defeat scene right when he begins to appear[/i][/p][p][i]- Updated visuals on spears and gave them sound effects. They are also faster, making them more dangerous but also more predictable.[/i][/p][p][i]- You can now press ESC to leave item and consumable replacement menues[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed the left and right hands of temerion to be empowered on instanity difficulty[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed you to cast spells while holding up your shield[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the mage at top of the Dark Tower to not move around if you press ESC menu and wait for his intro dialog to end[/i][/p][p][i]- fixed an issue with chests that spawned its loot too far to the right[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue where Crown of Chainlightning would spawn its lightning below the Hands of Temerion so it could not hit them properly[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with Overcharged Ring that spawned thunderbolts above the player instead of from its center[/i][/p][p][i]- Nerfed the attack speed skill from +7% to +6%[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused you to not be able to use your main hand when you activate and deactivate frost shell spell on your off hand[/i][/p][p][i]- Shards that enhance physical damage now also applies to the shockwave you make when blocking damage with shield[/i][/p][p][i]- Added more guards to stand post at the well once its cleansed. Those on the right side now also look to the right instead of to the left[/i][/p][p][i]- Corrected saving so it now actually saves how many times you have died[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the player to spawn at the center of the Sanctum if you just left Gilzera's throneroom. Same if you walk into GIlzera's throneroom you also start at the middle. You should start from the sides.[/i][/p][p][i]- Added a "press ESC to skip" on scenes, and in case of controller support, its either O or B[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that allowed for super fast sword swinging when pressing sword right after using a breath spell[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused the player to only make walking sounds 2 times and then remain silent until turning around or touching another floor[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug with UI buttons causing them to overlap. When hovering your mouse over, the sound would get progressively louder.[/i][/p][p][i]- Added a flash effect when dodge cooldown ends[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused consumables to not switch correctly when standing too far away from it while replacing it.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused breath spells to bug out when pressing their respective spell button, causing its sound to get very loud.[/i][/p][p][i]- Added visual cooldown on shields[/i][/p][p][i]- Nerfed wooden shield, increasing its cooldown by 20%[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed an issue with Otai who completely ignored when the player dodges, thus being able to damage you mid-dodge ... rude.[/i][/p][p][i]- Natalys no longer makes footstep sounds as she technically hovers[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed a bug that caused Charm of Featherfall to permanently reduce fall damage, even to the point where you gain health from falling xD[/i] [/p]

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
[b]Hey you guys![/b]

I have just released a quick hotfix based on some bugs you have found since the major patch yesterday. Thanks so much for the feedback, keep it coming!

Stay hydrated,
- Plant

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png[/img]


[b]What has been fixed:[/b]

[i]- Fixed an issue where player stats where not affected by Challenge difficulty when you start with Challenge from the main menu. 

- Fixed a major bug that caused the game to zoom in so much that the game does not even show pixels anymore. This happened when going out of focus which opens the ESC menu and then closing the ESC menu down. 

- i MIGHT have fixed the bug that causes Gerion to get stuck, unable to move at all except through dodging. Do let me know if it still persists.

- Fixed a bug that caused Frost Shell to remain active even when dead and after returning to life[/i]

notes.title: Major fix and settings patch!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I have here an awesome update that fixes a ton of issues and bugs, polishes and balances a vast number of things in Godstone. But most importantly: It massively improves the settings system, giving you more flexibility with volume and keybindings - and your settings now save! 
So when you leave the game and go back, you won't have to redo the settings all over again!

Can't wait to participate in the big Steam Next Fest February 24.
Stay hydrated,
- Plant

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png[/img]

[b]Full list of changes:[/b]

- Fixed an issue in the volume settings where the bars reset when leaving and entering the settings menu. 

- Added Ambience and Footsteps volume meters in the settings menu

- Added dodge keybinding in the settings menu

- Settings now actually save when you leave the game!! 

- Due to popular request, the default inventory shortcut is moved from I to TAB, and skill shortcut from K to C

- Fixed effects sound setting. A number of sounds were not affected by this setting.

- Removed some setting buttons that were not used and really had no effect

- Improved Crown descriptions and ensured its text did not overlap with the "you already use this." note

- Nerfed Crown of Winter: The shards can no longer chill, which means they cannot cause a level-clearing chain reaction by themselves anymore

- Nerfed Tome of Swiftness from +10% attack speed to +5% attack speed.

- You can now ESC out of Game Over menu

- The game now pauses when going out of focus

- Fixed a bug that allowed missiles from fire traps to collide with the player despite dodging.

- Nerfed Charm of Destruction. It now causes a simple explosion dealing 2 damage around the dying enemy instead of erupting in missiles that basically one shotted all nearby enemies.

- Changed health of following enemies
Skeletal Archer from 12 to 10
Skeletal Warrior from 12 to 14
dashing stone golem from 12 to 14
Flying golem head from 10 to 9
Bandit from 9 to 13
Mages from 12 to 11

- Updated Ezemat's sprite art to fit his icon artwork. Aka he has gone goth

- Fixed a bug that caused the ESC menu to be affected by zoom

- Fixed some typo's (My english teacher would be proud)

- Buffed Orb of Frost and Orb of Fire spells. Their damage goes up from 3.5 to 4.5. The damage dealt when passing through enemies is doubled.

- Reduced the screen shake when Azar Zeion's Tomb is collapsing

- Fixed an issue where players accidentally skipped the first part of dialog by clicking too fast

- Skeletal warrior's movement speed is now boosted when having the speed empowerment

- Fixed a bug that allowed Bandit's throwing knife to collide with the player while dodging

- Fixed an issue where Bandit attacks ignored dodge. Rude.

- In the inventory, the title 'spells' is replaced with 'equipment', as swords/shields have been introduced and its no longer just spells like in the good old days. 'Crowns and Relics' title have also been fixed.

- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to dash into the next level and skipping the entire level. This even worked to skip Alva's magic scene as well as the Briar bossfight

- Fixed an issue with demo map showing incorrect levels

- Fixed a bug that caused UI to vanish when returning to the start of the demo after completing it

- Screen now shakes when opening Azar Zeion's Tomb

- Increased damage done by spikes, dart arrows and spear traps. They are now a proper threat *evil smiley*

- Fixed a bug that allowed to press E while in dialog while standing next to an urn to break that urn

- Made orb of flames and orb of frost nova missiles slightly transparent to make them less visually overwhelming *eye-pain begone!*

- Increased chill and burn debuff from orb of flames and orb of frost

- Fixed burn effect on golems that displayed it to its far right, and its health bar which was also not centered

- Renamed Orb of Nephis to Orb of Darkness. Also fixed the spawn coordinates for the Neferin Bolt it casts on attack

- Fixed a bug that allowed spells to collide with Corpse Leaper even when its dead

- Put thunder mage missiles in front of player missiles so they are easier to detect. The missile tail has also been shortened to make them more visually manageable

- Fixed an issue with Spark and Snowflake causing them to not properly damage enemies if they stand too close to a wall

- Spark and Snowflake emit more light

- Ensured Frost Shell and Black Circle spells only drop as off hand. This makes sure you always have some damage-dealing ability, otherwise you risk getting stuck in the game

- Fixed a major bug that caused the player to vanish and unable to attack when disabling Frost Shell

- Balanced blood effects by adding cooldown to prevent it from going SPLATTERSPLATTERSPLATTER nonstop when using firebreath or frostbreath on it

- Changed spell descriptions so they no longer say 'penetrate enemies', but instead 'pierce enemies' ... because ... because that sounds cooler m'kay

- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to both use off hand spells and sword at the same time, leaving multiple animations overlapping

- Fixed a bug that caused melee attack to instantly end when trying to use it after having used a breath ability

- Corrected spawn coordinates for the elemental empowerment on Ilzetath that previously caused the fire and frost missiles to appear too far to the right. He now also casts a missile whenever he summons fire runes, similar to the normal fire wizard.

- Polished the UI, removing the big vault key icon on the far left corner and instead have a smaller key icon appear right next to the inventory button. This leaves the UI with much better symmetry (and my OCD satisfied)

- Fixed a bug that allowed the health bar to show 0 health when you are very VERY close to death

- Increased dodge cooldown by 50%. Sorry folks, its just too powerful :p

- Shortened Neferin Breath description to make space for 'already using this' note

- Birds and bats now react to player spells. If the player tries to cast magic at them, they will fly when the missile gets too close

- Centered Briar's bombs on her body when casting them to the left. They appeared behind her before

- Fixed a damn bug where the first level of Ilzetath's library would reset when backtracking. As you can hear this bug has 'buggled' my mind for some time now

- Nerfed poison damage from 1.5 per second to 0.9 per second.

- Fixed a bug that allowed you to spawn an infinite amount of portals by repeatedly opening and closing Ilzetath's note

- Vault doors and levers now display their E notification lower if they are located on the upper part of a level. This ensures it does not go out of screen border.

- Items, weapons, consumables etc found on the upper side of the screen now display info below them, as to not cover over the player character

- Fixed a bug where item information would flimmer for just a frame on the top left corner before appearing at the item itself

- Gerion no longer flashes you when trying to move during a scene

- Gerion no longer runs in place when pressing both left movement and right movement at the same time

- Remade the Frost Spike sound effect. This one is less invasive/annoying to listen to, though I'm still not 100p satisfied with how it sounds, so it most likely will change again in the future

- Fixed a bug that caused Hezel to have some kind of brain damage where he thinks you have saved him if you leave and re-enter the room

- Updated button visuals in the ESC menu

notes.title: Polish, fixes and polish
notes.content:
While the Early Access is taking shape, I have also been working through the feedback you guys have given me over these past couple of days. Next Fest nears, and Godstone needs to be as [i]scrumptious[/i] as possible. 

[i]Stay hydrated!
- Plant[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png[/img]

notes.title: Brand new demo live now!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to the new demo of Godstone![/b][/h1]

It has been a while, and after tons of planning, development and writing, I bring you guys a new experience. This new demo takes place just before you make it to Palathian through the lethal swamps surrounding the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ea7b4e03d8359498e9dfab0784fb3750aa068b15.png[/img]

Play as Gerion, a warrior from the far west who travels with a cloaked stranger. But old enemies have made their way to Palathian as well, plunging their journey into an unexpected twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/b3e1bf9a5c2af97a27ecfbadbe42ad3004035513.png[/img]

But it does not end here! The choices you make in-game also changes how the story plays out in dramatic ways. There are also entire secret areas, multiple paths and a merciless new challenge difficulty for those who want an extra ... well, challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/0c7ff84ecb3dcd3f54e519bea11f1d4b00f67e13.png[/img]

I can't wait for you guys to explore this new version of Godstone. Its world is a huge passion of mine, and I want to see it be the best it can possibly get.

[i]With that said, I hope you have a great new year! Stay hydrated![/i]
[i]Plant[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ee9662871cf00ef180cd1e0eec461d21138d9964.png[/img]


[b]Questions and Answers[/b]

[i]What about the old demo?[/i]
Fret not. The contents of the old demo are not lost, and will be reintroduced in their overhauled version along with the Early Access Launch.

[i]What about the other playable characters?[/i]
In this demo, you can only play as Gerion as this part of the game only tells his story. The other four playable characters will become unlock-able with the Early Access version with their own stories to tell.

notes.title: Winter Mania is here!
notes.content:
[b]Hey you guys![/b]


Thank you so much for sticking around and playing Godstone! I hope you are cozy and warm with some hot cocoa, enjoying that winter atmosphere. 
To celebrate December, I have worked extra hard to bring you guys a brand new minigame to Godstone; Winter Mania!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/ddef0d377f7f5349ae3ccc0300848a0bbdc25024.png[/img]







[b]About Winter Mania[/b]
Play as Alakai in this endless minigame, introducing 3 new snow-based enemies along with a final bossrush! Get powerups after each wave of snowmen, build the best synergies and stay alive for as long as you can!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342136/a19d33d48dba7e736df484c6fb9a77d0b65439a2.png[/img]








Along with all of this, I have also added 2 new items for the base game, as well as a bunch of polish, balancing and bugfixing!


[list]
[*] All items that only affect organic enemies now affect all enemies.

[*] Decreased the intensity of screen shake in all bossfights.

[*] Removed a bunch of containers from areas that also have combat, decreasing the amount that appear, but increasing the value gained from them in general.

[*] Altered and polished a bunch of maps

[*] Changed the Tome of Swiftness powerup: It only grants attack speed and not movement speed. This is due to movement speed messing up with multiple bossfights. Instead, the attack speed bonus is increased from 2.5% to 10%.

[*] Changed the Swiftness Skill. It no longer grants movement speed. In return, the attack speed bonus is increased from 5% to 10%.

[*] Reduced the energy cost of Ablans Mastery from 10 to 5.

[*] Increased the hitbox of Ablans Mastery, making it easier to hit enemies

[*] The Map now better shows how far you are by adding a “/ 17” next to the currently reached level

[*] There is now a 50% chance that either The Keeper or Otai spawn in each playthrough. Both can also spawn in the same playthrough if lucky (or unlucky).

[*] The map now shows what boss will appear in the current playthrough instead of their general spawn places

[*] Fixed an error were Otai spawns at the wrong level compared to the map

[*] Fake walls are now marked with a faint symbol

[*] Orb spells no longer bounce on walls.

[*] Black Circle spell now emits light

[*] Raven Charm Relic also has an effect on enemies cursed with Sleep

[*] Fixed an issue were screen shake did not work at level 6

[*] Added 7 new maps.

[*] Changed Neferin Lords (the floating skulls): Instead of spreading blood when it dies, it spreads blood were it floats by default. Blood no longer chills the player when touching it, but will keep healing enemies that walk on it.

[*] Added a new crown; Trinity! 
For each enemy cursed, burning and chilled, comets fall down from above. These comets are either fire, frost or neferin and deal 25% extra damage to enemies affected by their debuff type. Fire deals bonus damage to burn etc.

[*] Added 2 new items!
Emberglass: If an enemy is both cursed and chilled: They explode in fire at intervals, dealing extra damage to burning enemies.
Deathbell: When damaged below 10 endurance, unleash a nova that inflicts chill, burn and Taint on enemies nearby

[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bars sprites not to finish their animation if you exit the room right after the ambush has ended. When returning to the room, the bars will simply appear as closed, but they can be walked through.

[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the player to melee attack while invisible, without breaking invisibility

[*] Shortened how long doorways are closed after entering them
[/list]
